claim_being_audited: Whether the current release can be certified now despite a current pharmacy prior-authorization segment regression, based on aggregate readiness, clean rehearsal, prior family approval as context, and an asserted plan to disclose the limitation in model-card documentation.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation already reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Use suspicious when aggregate readiness evidence exists but a required policy predicate, support link, or approval record remains unresolved.
Do not treat prior approvals or informal monitoring notes as substitutes for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
If the current documentation and approval chain are produced, the verdict could move toward compliant or compliant_with_caveats depending on the exact record.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model-card or release-document text showing the pharmacy prior-authorization weakness is explicitly disclosed as a material limitation.
Provide evidence of review/approval for that current documentation tied to this release.
If disclosure is not present, provide the approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record that covers the segment weakness.
Provide the current evaluation artifact for the affected segment showing the cited 1.2 percentage-point gap and its materiality determination.
specific_concerns: The policy text requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation; the summary does not establish that this has already been done.
The actor's own packet treats the pharmacy prior-authorization regression as a current material limitation, which makes documentation status a gating predicate rather than a minor caveat.
Prior approval is expressly described as contextual only and therefore cannot carry the compliance case for the current release.
The existing monitoring comment is admitted to be informal and unreviewed, so it does not satisfy the policy's approved-mitigation or reviewed-risk-acceptance requirement.
Evidence access is limited to the actor summary, so there is no admissible proof here that the model card was updated, reviewed, and approved before certification.
unsupported_claims: That certification may proceed now on the current record.
That the required disclosure condition has already been satisfied in current release documentation.
That any approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covers the current subgroup weakness.
